field.label: Earnings
field.comment:
How it works
Every row is a card in the "Earn points" section of the loyalty page. The customer presses the button, the link opens in a new tab and the points are added to their Leat account right away. Each card can be claimed once per period (see Repeat).

Columns

  • Icon: the icon on the card, chosen from the list: general icons (cart, birthday, gift, heart, review, share, newsletter, generic) and social media icons (Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Snapchat, Twitch, Telegram, Spotify). Unknown or removed icons are shown as "generic". To change how an icon looks or to add your own, see "Changing and adding icons" below.
  • Title: shown on the card. Required, a row without a title is ignored.
  • Button text: the text on the button. When empty: "Claim" for cards with points, the title for cards without points.
  • Button link: opened in a new tab when the button is pressed (for example your Instagram page). For a card with points it is optional: without a link the button only claims the points, which suits things like "Add your birthday". A card without points needs a link to show a button at all.
  • Points: the points the customer gets per claim. With 0 the card is a plain link: nothing can be claimed, it never shows as completed and there is no points line below the title.
  • Repeat: once, every year, every month, every week or every day. Resets happen on calendar boundaries in the store's timezone: "every year" resets on 1 January, "every month" on the 1st, "every week" on Monday (ISO weeks) and "every day" at midnight.
  • Key: what a claim is locked on. Leave it empty on a new row and one is generated when you save. Allowed: letters, numbers, _ and - (max 64), unique within this table.

Changing and adding icons
Icons are image files that belong to the theme, so an admin cannot upload them here: adding one that is not in the list is a small job for a developer (about five minutes, no changes to the Leat module). Hand the steps below to your developer.

Change how an existing icon looks (same name, other image):

  1. Put an SVG with the exact name of the icon in your theme: app/design/frontend/<Vendor>/<theme>/Leat_LoyaltyFrontend/web/images/earn-points/<name>.svg, for example instagram.svg. The theme file wins over the one in the module.
  2. Deploy the static content and flush the cache.

Add a new icon to the dropdown:

  1. Create the SVG in the same theme folder, for example pinterest.svg (it has to be in the theme, another module's folder is not searched). The file name is the icon name: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only (pinterest, gift-box).
  2. Register the name in the etc/di.xml of a custom module (a theme cannot carry a di.xml, any module of your project can): 
    <type name="Leat\Loyalty\Model\EarnPoints\Icons">
    <arguments>
        <argument name="names" xsi:type="array">
            <item name="pinterest" xsi:type="string">pinterest</item>
        </argument>
    </arguments>
</type>
  3. Flush the cache (and run bin/magento setup:di:compile in production mode). The icon now shows in the Icon dropdown; choose it on a row and save.

Requirements for the SVG: viewBox="0 0 24 24" and stroke="currentColor" (or fill="currentColor") instead of fixed colours, so the icon takes the colour of the card (white on the dark tile); no fixed width/height attributes needed, the widget sizes it. The file is placed in the page as it is, so only use SVG files from a source you trust. Removing a name from di.xml later turns rows that use it into the "generic" icon, nothing else changes.

Good to know

  • Honor system: nothing checks that the customer really did the action (followed, subscribed, ...). Don't configure an earning you don't want to hand out on trust.
  • Changing a row: title, button text, link, icon and points can be changed freely. Customers who already claimed stay locked as long as the key and the repeat stay the same. A new points value only counts for new claims.
  • Making it claimable again: change the key or the repeat. Deleting a row only hides the card: the claims are kept, so adding a row back with the same key restores the lock.
  • Queue: points are credited immediately. When Leat can't be reached they are queued and retried automatically; the customer sees "Completed" either way.
  • Scope: this table is set per store view. A store view that overrides it should use the same keys to share the lock with the default table; with different keys customers can claim again there.

field.label: Note
field.comment:
All prices are exported as excl. tax by default. Use the options below to include shipping and/or tax as charges.
Include shipping as charge: adds shipping cost as a separate charge on the order.
Include tax as charge: adds order tax as a separate charge on the order.
Separate shipping and tax: when both options above are enabled, splits shipping tax into its own charge instead of bundling it with line-item tax.

Please be forewarned that orders are relatively project specific, and if you have a custom checkout-, order- or product-flow, it's crucial to test the order export functionality to ensure points are awarded correctly.
A basic implementation is provided that should work for most setups, but custom flows may require adjustments to the provided implementation.

For these circumstances, the payment method can be configured here and be marked as 'allowed for export to Leat'
despite being stuck on 'pending'.
